prerequisites: A Leadping account and organization are required.
The account holder must be able to complete the agent identity claim ceremony.
Production SMS and calling require an approved lead source, consent evidence, and applicable sender or carrier registration.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.requiredFor: Leadping workspace and API access for $60 USD per month, plus metered provider usage.

plans.name: Annual
plans.requiredFor: The same workspace and API access for $600 USD per year, plus metered provider usage.

verification.name: Agent identity claim
verification.description: The Leadping account holder signs in through the verification URL and gives the agent the displayed one-time code.

verification.name: Production communication readiness
verification.description: Lead sources, consent evidence, phone numbers, and carrier registration may require review before production SMS or calling is enabled.

mechanisms.description: An agent registers a service-auth identity without a bootstrap credential, completes a human claim ceremony, and exchanges the resulting assertion for a short-lived bearer token.

methods.notes: Initial service-auth registration requires only the account holder's email address; ownership is established by the human claim ceremony.

credentials.ttl: Access tokens last approximately 5 minutes; assertions and rotating refresh tokens are longer-lived.
credentials.rotation: Exchange the stored assertion for a new access token; refresh the identity when the assertion approaches expiry.

scopes.notes: OAuth tokens use openid, profile, and email scopes; resource authorization is additionally constrained by the authenticated Leadping user and organization.

economics.freeTier: No free API tier; API access is included with monthly and annual Leadping subscriptions.

gaps: The account holder must complete the interactive identity claim ceremony.
Production SMS and calling can require Leadping, carrier, or sender review after API credentials are available.
